name: Biei (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Biei town emblem in yellow: a stylised mountain of two peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Biei, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 February 1963.

features.role: Biei town emblem — a stylised mountain of two peaks
